verdict.rationale: Slack provides an official CLI (docs.slack.dev/tools/slack-cli), Web API, Events API, and an official MCP server for AI integrations, all documented in first-party docs — this is solid infrastructure for AI-native developers to build against. However, the evidence never explicitly names language-specific SDKs (e.g., Bolt for JS/Python/Java) despite hinting at 'pick the tool that fits how you work,' and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or completeness. Missing for 10: explicit SDK documentation/naming, independent developer corroboration of SDK reliability, OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s).
